House style: moderate Bokmål with three genders (ei/-a for feminine nouns, en/-en masculine, et/-et neuter), weak past in -et, neuter definite plural in -ene, sju and tjue, "ble", "ga". "Fløyen" is a real mountain at Bergen; the story gives no facts about it beyond its name. "tre / trær" is a neuter noun with an irregular plural.

sentences.text: Lørdag var det sol i Bergen. Anna og Lars jobbet ikke.
sentences.english: On Saturday there was sun in Bergen. Anna and Lars did not work.

sentences.text: De ville gå en tur. Sam og Nils ville gå også.
sentences.english: They wanted to go for a walk. Sam and Nils wanted to go too.

sentences.text: Fjellet heter Fløyen.
sentences.english: The mountain is called Fløyen.

sentences.text: De tok bussen til sentrum. Så gikk de.
sentences.english: They took the bus to the town centre. Then they walked.

sentences.text: Veien var lang. Mange folk gikk her.
sentences.english: The road was long. Many people walked here.

sentences.text: Jeg er sulten!
sentences.english: I am hungry!
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Her er brød og ost. Her er melk.
sentences.english: Here is bread and cheese. Here is milk.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Nils spiste brød med ost. Han var glad.
sentences.english: Nils ate bread with cheese. He was happy.

sentences.text: Veien er lang! Er fjellet høyt?
sentences.english: The road is long! Is the mountain high?
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Ja, det er høyt. Gå, Nils! Du kan gå!
sentences.english: Yes, it is high. Keep going, Nils! You can do it!
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Nils gikk. Han var trøtt, men han gråt ikke.
sentences.english: Nils walked. He was tired, but he did not cry.

sentences.text: Nå var de på fjellet.
sentences.english: Now they were on the mountain.

sentences.text: Se byen! Jeg ser kirka og skolen!
sentences.english: Look at the town! I see the church and the school!
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Klinikken er stor! Huset mitt er lite!
sentences.english: The clinic is big! My house is small!
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Skolen min er liten!
sentences.english: My school is small!
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Det var en bra dag.
sentences.english: It was a good day.

sentences.text: De gikk hjem. Veien var ikke lang.
sentences.english: They went home. The road was not long.

sentences.text: I byen drakk de kaffe og te. Nils drakk melk.
sentences.english: In town they drank coffee and tea. Nils drank milk.

sentences.text: Jeg vil gå hver lørdag!
sentences.english: I want to go every Saturday!
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Ja, turen var bra. Du er ikke trøtt nå?
sentences.english: Yes, the walk was good. You are not tired now?
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Ja, jeg er trøtt, men jeg er glad.
sentences.english: Yes, I am tired, but I am happy.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Sam tenkte: «Det er høyt, men turen var bra.»
sentences.english: Sam thought: "It is high, but the walk was good."

sentences.text: På turen er telefonen til Sam borte. Han leter lenge. Den ligger i vesken, under jakka.
sentences.english: On the walk Sam's phone is gone. He looks for a long time. It is in the bag, under the jacket.

sentences.text: Etter turen er Nils syk. Han har feber og vondt i hodet, og han må hvile.
sentences.english: After the walk Nils is ill. He has a fever and a headache, and he has to rest.

sentences.text: Nils husket vesken på turen, og han gråt ikke. Lars tenkte at det var bra.
sentences.english: Nils remembered the bag on the walk, and he did not cry. Lars thought that was good.
